correctness.rationale: For each fixed nondegenerate m-gon with independent arclength-uniform boundary samples, on the exponentially likely event that every edge is occupied the missing hull area is the sum of disjoint corner triangles (sin(theta_i)/2)*a_i*b_i. Joint microscopic endpoint avoidance gives independent standard exponential gaps after scaling by N/P; Hölder plus exponential tails and the exponentially rare complement prove convergence of every fixed integer moment, not just weak convergence. Since E[(EF)^k]=(k!)^2, the moment-cumulant set-partition identity counts cumulants by transitive ordered permutation pairs (first four 1,3,26,426), and Newton identities recover the unordered sine spectrum from first m positive cumulants. Cauchy gives R>=3/m, strict angle-polytope concavity gives R<3/2, and the connected allowed angle region plus explicit degenerate sequences gives the entire [3/m,3/2) image. Solving equal-sine supplemental-angle equation classifies m=3, m=4, and m>=5 equality families. Jensen establishes the mean bound. Independent exact integer cumulant and exceptional-angle numerical checks corroborate finite coefficients only.
residual_risks: Only fixed polygons and each fixed moment; no uniformity in degenerating polygons. Independent computations are finite and do not prove limit laws.
